plan: FREE only, when eligible; no Paid upgrade and no unsupported service activation
account_preconditions: Verify actual Free plan ACTIVE status, expiration, remaining credits, eligible services and other project consumption immediately before application.
Owner approves the concrete CloudFormation resource list and domain before deployment.
Remain local if eligibility or coverage is unavailable.

public_ipv4.type: one Elastic IP for stable owner-provided HTTPS DNS

cloudfront.mode: Pay-as-you-go only if covered by Free account credits; no flat-rate plan enrollment

database.restore: New empty database, verified logical dump, matching schema revision

estimate.notes: Continuous two-month planning scenario, 730 hours/month, before free allowances. Fixed Ohio rates verified using AWS Price List. S3 assumes 10 GB including versions/backups; CDN 16 GB plus 4 GB direct private transfer. CDN/request figures remain planning allowances, not a usage cap or forecast. Add other account workloads and keep the USD 20 reserve. No Paid upgrade or additional credit awards assumed.

stop_behavior: Compute stops; retained EBS, Elastic IP, stored object versions and CDN traffic continue consuming eligible credits.
expiry_policy: Export and verify local database/files before credit depletion or account closure. Free account closure can remove access to resources/data; retain at least two local copies.

models.default_generation: Owner-selected Groq server configuration may provide conversation; local extractive fallback. IaC enables no provider by itself.

selected_local_trial.embedding_model: qwen3-embedding:0.6b, 1024 dimensions; installed digest pinned in external configuration
selected_local_trial.generation_model: qwen3:4b, Q4_K_M; installed following explicit owner authorization; evaluation pending acceptance
selected_local_trial.host: Owner Windows PC with RTX 4060 Laptop 8 GiB; not the proposed t3.small API host
selected_local_trial.state: Historical PC-only experiment; not selected for this AWS deployment and no AWS-to-PC model connection is proposed.
selected_local_trial.networking: Native API and model remain on the PC during local development. Any AWS-to-PC connectivity requires a concrete secure delivery design and owner approval; no public model port.
selected_local_trial.availability: Requires inference PC awake and reachable. This is not continuous hosting.
selected_local_trial.small_model_trial: qwen3:0.6b installed only for evaluation; not activated as visitor guide

models.prerecorded_narration: ElevenLabs Studio, exported audio files; provider upload and quotas must be handled separately
models.dynamic_voice: Owner-selected Groq transcription and ElevenLabs TTS configuration, with pinned local Piper fallback. Processing consent and provider quotas must be retained; no client-side keys.
models.external_processing: External processing requires owner-selected server-only configuration and consent. Runtime IAM has no AWS AI invocation permission. No provider account, key or quota is inferred from connected sessions.

credit_budget.rule: Remain on Free plan. Do not upgrade or activate uncovered services. A budget alert is not a spending cap. Verify account-wide consumption, including retained storage/IP and other projects, before each session and export before expiry.
